neighbor_source_select.basis: The top concatenates {HIGH, LOW} into the two-source vector, and Stream_Engine_Connect indexes that vector with nse_*_slice_sel.

wreg.behavior: WREG is routed to exactly the matching 5-bit slice id, pulses the selected leaf valid for one FSM cycle, supplies a 5-bit leaf address and 32-bit data, then returns to IDLE. Other decoded commands use the 28-bit mask.

control_behavior.CMPT: asserts sem2iga_exec_start and waits for slice_cmpt_finish
control_behavior.BARR: constant is declared but no barr_cmd_vld or FSM state is implemented in Slice_Execution_Manager

derived_capacity.classification: arithmetic derived from logical RTL parameters, not a board capacity approval

logical_dram.remote_request_rule: Read and write MSE logic marks a request remote when the top five bank-address bits differ from SLICE_ID.

specialized_array.ports: 3 input groups and 1 output group; each group exposes 8 lanes of 32-bit data
specialized_array.int8_operand_semantics: Each byte of FMA DataA is converted from signed two's-complement magnitude and its sign bits are carried separately; DataB bytes are consumed without sign conversion. The observable primitive is therefore signed-A by unsigned-B, pending system-level operand assignment approval.
specialized_array.psum_and_bias: FMA DataC is the outbuffer psum feedback. Input group 2 supplies the initial outbuffer value when bias is enabled; when disabled the control block substitutes zero. The outbuffer tags initial and subsequent ALU values as psum and feeds them back.
specialized_array.wreg_config: SA leaf address 0 replaces the packed SA config register. sa_enable itself is asserted by the streamed configure-valid path, not by the WREG branch.

general_array.ports: 3 input groups and 1 output group; groups expose 8 lanes of 32-bit data
general_array.constant_primitive: Each PE has three 32-bit constant-capable inputs selected by inport mode 11.
general_array.constant_wreg_caveat: The source asserts constant_valid for WREG leaf address INPORT_ID+1, but selects WREG data as constant_value only for INPORT_ID+2. This apparent address mismatch is not resolved by static reading.
general_array.wreg_config: GA PE and GA outport WREG branches update packed configuration storage, but their enable/configure-finish state is asserted by the streamed configure-valid path rather than by WREG alone.
general_array.int32_to_uint8: Negative values clamp to 0, any set bit in [30:8] clamps to 255, otherwise [7:0] is emitted. No scale multiplication, zero-point addition, or rounding occurs in this output primitive.

arrays_and_int8_primitives.conv_statement: No named Conv or convolution block exists in the authoritative RTL closure. Convolution can only be a compiler/firmware mapping onto stream engines plus SA/GA primitives; that mapping is not fixed by these primitives.
arrays_and_int8_primitives.requant_statement: No named requant, qparam, zero-point, or quantization-scale field was found in the authoritative RTL closure. Available conversions/constants are primitives, not a numerically complete requant contract.

reserved_axi.role_at_top: host-facing AXI slave-style channel despite the m_axi_reserved prefix

global_registers.decode: After subtracting NDP_AXI_BASE_ADDR=0, addresses whose [31:28] nibble equals GLB_REG_BASE_ADDR[31:28]=8 route to the register slave; all other addresses are forwarded.

0x80000010.behavior: both bits auto-clear when the following cycle has no register write handshake

global_registers.execution_length_behavior: init_exec_inst_length controls 128-bit AXI read beats: the fetch counter increments once per 128-bit response handshake, while FIFO_128to64 splits every beat into two 64-bit commands. Firmware must not assume the field counts 64-bit commands without owner approval.
global_registers.finish_behavior: A slice finish bit is set only after the global queue is empty, fetch_finish is set, that slice local queue is empty, and slice2gexec_ready is true.

load.candidate: Use m_axi_reserved writes outside the 0x8... register-decode region to reach the forwarded internal AXI fabric. Place 128-bit execution beats at init_exec_base_addr; a CFG command may in turn fetch 64-bit configuration words from its 22-bit base address and multicast them to its 28-bit slice mask.

start.candidate: Write base/length to 0x80000000, then write bit 0 at 0x80000010.

wait.candidate: Poll 0x80000020. Require fetch_finish, no overflow, and all intended exec_slice_finish bits; host timeout and error policy are not defined in RTL.

dump.candidate: The non-register m_axi_reserved read path is forwarded, so memory readback is structurally possible.
dump.missing: No authoritative top-level dump command, output address/layout, coherency rule, completion fence, or board/driver API is present in the active filelist. Testbench waveform dumps are not a hardware dump interface.

approval_required.decision: Approve NDP_Top_new plus NDP_Top_filelist.f as the build authority, provide MC_DIR/DIR_HOME/vendor libraries, and return a clean elaboration log from a simulator that supports protected128.
approval_required.why: Static inspection and a failed Icarus attempt cannot establish build closure.

approval_required.decision: Approve the physical base address presented to m_axi_reserved, the 0x8 register window, forwarded DRAM address map, APB initialization, clock/reset sequencing, and logical-to-physical bank/ECC mapping.
approval_required.why: Logical RTL geometry is fixed, but the active physical model advertises 13 row bits, 7 column bits, and 144-bit array data before entering an encrypted body.

approval_required.decision: Approve the 64-bit command ABI, 128-bit execution-list packing order, execution-length unit, CFG length convention, address alignment, reset/start ordering, and status polling mask.
approval_required.why: Register writes have identifiable side effects, but list construction and host policy are not specified by the register RTL.

approval_required.decision: Approve which tensor is placed on signed DataA versus unsigned DataB, the byte/lane ordering, zero-point treatment, accumulator signedness/overflow expectations, and bias layout/type.
approval_required.why: The primitive is observably signed-A by unsigned-B and seeds psum from input group 2; this does not by itself define a correct ResNet50 Conv binding.

approval_required.decision: Provide and validate an end-to-end requant recipe: scale representation, zero-point addition, rounding rule, saturation, per-channel qparam layout, and the exact GA/SA instruction sequence. Clarify the GA constant WREG address mismatch.
approval_required.why: The visible INT32-to-UINT8 block only clamps; it does not perform scale or rounding, and no named qparam register exists.

approval_required.decision: Approve Conv lowering, tiling, padding/stride mapping, DRAM placement, buffer lifetime, HIGH/LOW route selection, slice masking, synchronization, and a measured performance configuration.
approval_required.why: RTL fixes primitive reactions, not a numerically correct or high-performance schedule.

approval_required.decision: Approve output placement, completion fence, readback/dump API, transfer sizes, cache/coherency behavior, and comparison format.
approval_required.why: Forwarded reads exist, but no authoritative dump contract does.

approval_required.decision: Approve timeout/error handling and whether a barrier is required; clarify BARR opcode 110, which is declared but not decoded by the slice FSM.
approval_required.why: Polling bits are visible, but a robust wait/synchronization contract is not.
